episodes.synopsis: A schoolyard fight leads to a chance encounter between Miyano and Sasaki. As their friendship blossoms and Miyano introduces Sasaki to Boys' Love manga, Sasaki wrestles with newfound and unfamiliar feelings.
episodes.title: First Time

episodes.synopsis: The school year slowly marches forward. As Sasaki and Miyano's relationship deepens, the other guys at school take notice. Sasaki struggles with the intensity of his feelings.
episodes.title: Someone I Like

episodes.synopsis: As Miyano continues lending Sasaki BL manga, he worries he might be bringing Sasaki negative attention. Miyano begins to question the nature of Sasaki's relationship with him.
episodes.title: Senpai Is...

episodes.synopsis: Sasaki becomes less and less able to hide his feelings. Ogasawara gets fujoshi help from a fudanshi. Miyano continues to question his relationship with Sasaki.
episodes.title: Limit

episodes.synopsis: Sasaki finally decides to tell Miyano how he feels. However, Sasaki's nerves get to him and make him say the wrong thing. Can he find a way to fix his mistake?
episodes.title: Bit by Bit

episodes.synopsis: Miyano struggles to define his feelings for Sasaki, but in a rare moment alone with Sasaki, Miyano finds the the courage to open up about his feelings.
episodes.title: Feelings

episodes.synopsis: As Sasaki does his best to wait patiently for Miyano's answer about his feelings, a familiar face from Miyano's past gives Miyano a new perspective.
episodes.title: I Don't Want to Pressure Him

episodes.synopsis: Ogasawara gets Miyano's help with another lovers' quarrel. Preparations for the cultural festival begin in earnest. As the Chairman helps Miyano with his look for the cross-dressing competition, Miyano seeks his wisdom about love.
episodes.title: Realization

episodes.synopsis: Miyano struggles to figure out what to tell Sasaki. Sasaki gets sick. The day of the cultural festival finally arrives.
episodes.title: I Want to Take Care of You, Senpai

episodes.synopsis: The Cultural Festival begins and everyone is focused on their attractions. Miyano arranges with her senpai to have lunch together and check around. Meanwhile, he continues to reflect on his feelings towards Sasaki.
episodes.title: Love

episodes.synopsis: Miyano finally knows how he feels. Despite his newfound confidence in his feelings, Miyano struggles to find the right time to tell Sasaki. Did he wait too long?
episodes.title: What Do I Do About These Feelings?

episodes.synopsis: Now that Miyano is sure of his feelings, he can finally tell Sasaki. However, a misunderstanding threatens to derail everything.
episodes.title: Tomorrow
